name: dora-escalation-demo
title: DORA Escalation Demo
description: OCG §22.8 escalation-record demo. DORA readiness diagnostic gates on grade: grade F escalates to human review (run HALTs, open escalation record attached). Any passing grade (D or above) continues to DORA incident classification. Demonstrates skipped_by_escalation, deterministic record_hash, and both-branch fixture coverage.

steps.handoff: DORA readiness grade. GATE: grade='F' escalates to human review (OCG §22.8). Default (any grade != F) continues to the reporting-clock stage.
2025/301 Art. 5 stage-clock schedule (initial, intermediate, final) over caller-declared stage timestamps and entity class. Second of three stages.
2024/1772 Art. 8(1) major-incident determination over the Art. 9 threshold limbs, with the 2025/301 stage schedule in the same artifact. Final stage.
